subject: 05_Soft_Computing

questions.question: When is a fuzzy controller the right tool?
questions.question_ar: متى يكون المتحكم الضبابي الأداة المناسبة؟
questions.explanation: An FLC suits nonlinear, time-varying and noisy systems.
questions.explanation_ar: المتحكم الضبابي يناسب الأنظمة غير الخطية والمتغيرة والمشوشة.

questions.question: Which components make up a fuzzy logic controller?
questions.question_ar: أي مكونات تشكّل متحكماً منطقياً ضبابياً؟
questions.explanation: An FLC fuzzifies, infers over the rules, then defuzzifies.
questions.explanation_ar: المتحكم يحوّل ضبابياً، يستدل عبر القواعد، ثم يزيل التغبيش.

questions.question: In Mamdani, the rule consequent is what?
questions.question_ar: في ممداني، ما هو لاحق القاعدة؟
questions.explanation: A Mamdani consequent is a fuzzy set, later defuzzified.
questions.explanation_ar: لاحق ممداني مجموعة ضبابية، تُزال تغبيشها لاحقاً.

questions.question: In Takagi-Sugeno, the rule consequent is what?
questions.question_ar: في تاكاغي-سوغينو، ما هو لاحق القاعدة؟
questions.explanation: A Takagi-Sugeno consequent is a function of the inputs.

questions.question: Which is a Mamdani advantage?
questions.explanation: Mamdani rules stay linguistic, so they are easy to read and explain.
questions.explanation_ar: قواعد ممداني تبقى لغوية، فسهلة القراءة والشرح.

questions.question: Which is a Takagi-Sugeno advantage?
questions.explanation: Takagi-Sugeno is more accurate and faster but less interpretable.
questions.explanation_ar: تاكاغي-سوغينو أدق وأسرع لكن أقل قابلية للتفسير.

questions.question: How does the number of fuzzy rules grow with the input variables?
questions.question_ar: كيف ينمو عدد القواعد الضبابية مع متغيرات الإدخال؟
options: with the product of their term counts
with the sum of their term counts
with the largest term count only
with the number of outputs alone here
options_en: with the product of their term counts
with the sum of their term counts
with the largest term count only
with the number of outputs alone here
questions.explanation: Every combination of terms from every input becomes one rule, so the counts multiply.
questions.explanation_ar: كل توليفة من حدود كل مدخل تصبح قاعدة، فالأعداد تتضارب لا تتجمع.

questions.question: How is a rule firing strength computed?
questions.explanation: The firing strength is the minimum of the antecedent grades.
questions.explanation_ar: قوة الإطلاق هي أدنى درجات المقدمة، أي أضعف شرط في القاعدة.
